text:
Jordan (Sales): Quick heads up — client completed POC review today and wants all POC resources torn down by EOD Friday. They explicitly asked for keys revoked and model data removed.
Alex Chen: Do they want anything retained for a short quarantine window or full immediate wipe?
Jordan (Sales): Legal says preserve audit trail for 90 days but otherwise full purge now.
Maya Kapoor: OK. We'll invalidate API keys and remove pools. Need exact key IDs and pool names to avoid mistakes.
Samir Patel: Resources used: dedicated-poc-01 (4xA100), spot-burst-poc-03. Hosted keys created: hk_poc_8a1 and hk_poc_9b2.
Jordan (Sales): Client security contact is @rachael.hunt — she validated the request.
Alex Chen: Cleanup plan: 1) Revoke hosted API keys 2) Disable routing and drain dedicated pools 3) Purge model KV/prefix caches 4) Snapshot redacted server logs to compliance for 90d 5) Record KMS rotation and deletion events.
Maya Kapoor: Two security notes: redact any PII in logs before copying, and capture KMS key change event IDs.
Samir Patel: I'll run commands now. Canary first, then full.
Samir Patel: commands:
```bash
# revoke hosted keys
redwoodctl keys revoke --id hk_poc_8a1
redwoodctl keys revoke --id hk_poc_9b2
# disable routing to POC pools
redwoodctl routes update --name poc-default-route --disabled true
# drain pool
redwoodctl pools drain --name dedicated-poc-01 --grace 1200
# delete pool after successful drain
redwoodctl pools delete --name dedicated-poc-01 --confirm
```
Alex Chen: KV purge (post-key-revoke)
```bash
redwoodctl kv purge --namespace poc-tenant-453 --yes --confirm
```
Samir Patel: For spot-burst-poc-03 we'll scale to zero then delete to avoid billing blips.
Maya Kapoor: Checklist for artifacts: screenshot of key revocation, pool delete audit IDs, KMS rotation event, redaction log, compliance S3 path. Attach all to ticket.
Jordan (Sales): I'll open the closure ticket and CC legal + client.
deploy-bot: pipeline triggered: job poc/cleanup-run by Samir.
infra-oncall: Reminder — ensure fallback policies are off so no traffic is rerouted to other clients during teardown.
Samir Patel: Acknowledged. Disabling fallbacks now.
Alex Chen: After everything, I'll run quick verification: try old keys (expect 401) and check pool endpoints (should not accept new inferences).
Jordan (Sales): Timeline: revokes & routing disable (immediate), drain (in 1h), deletes & kv purge (in 2h), compliance snapshot (now). If all OK, I'll notify client and legal.
Maya Kapoor: If any unexpected dataset shows up during purge, pause and alert security immediately.
Samir Patel: Starting step 1.
deploy-bot: job poc/cleanup-run finished: success.
Samir Patel: Completed steps: hosted keys revoked, dedicated-poc-01 drained and deleted, spot-burst-poc-03 scaled-to-zero and deleted. KV purge executed. KMS rotation logged. Artifacts: https://redwood.internal/tickets/POC-8991/artifacts
Alex Chen: Smoke tests: revoked keys produce 401, no model responses on former endpoints. Logs attached.
Maya Kapoor: Compliance bucket: s3://redwood-compliance/poc-8991/audit-90d/ — logs redacted and stored.
Jordan (Sales): Email to client + legal sent. Keeping ticket open as audit-only until 90d retention completes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
